timeclock.title: Timeclock
timeclock.description: Clock in when your shift starts and out when it ends. Your supervisor reviews punches before payroll.
timeclock.unscheduled: Clock in without a scheduled shift
timeclock.unscheduledHelp: For call-ins and cover. Your supervisor will review it.
timeclock.locationNote: When you clock in we check, once, that you're at the facility. We don't track your location.
timeclock.noPunches: No punches in the last two weeks.

location.LOW_ACCURACY: Clocked in. Your location was unclear, so your supervisor will check this punch.
location.NO_LOCATION: Clocked in without location. Your supervisor will check this punch.

timeOff.title: Time off
timeOff.description: Ask for time away. If it's approved, your shifts in that time go to the board for others to cover.
timeOff.emptyBody: Requests you send appear here with their answer.
timeOff.protectedHint: You're entitled to this leave under employment standards. You don't need to share medical details.
timeOff.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: When you can work each week. The scheduling assistant only offers you shifts inside these times.
availability.effectiveHint: Earlier weeks keep your old availability.
availability.endBeforeStart: Each time must end after it starts.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.description: Take attendance on the deck. It saves on your phone first and uploads when there's signal.
lessons.offline: You're offline. Showing rosters saved at {{time}}. Your marks will upload when you reconnect.
lessons.emptyTitle: No lessons in the next week

ops.title: Water chemistry
ops.description: Record water tests. Out-of-range readings recommend a closure for a head guard to confirm.
ops.recordHelp: Values in ppm. Leave blank what you didn't test.
ops.bathersHint: Used to work out how many guards are needed.

done.CONFIRM: Pool closed. The front desk sees it now.

ops.seeReport: Showing a filtered report. Open Report to see it.
ops.reportHelp: Every reading with its limits check and sign-off, for inspections and your records.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Reports are encrypted. Opening one asks for a reason and is logged.
incidents.fileHelp: Write what happened while it's fresh. Stick to facts.
incidents.peopleHint: Roles and ages are enough, e.g. "swimmer, about 9".
incidents.filedBody: Your supervisor has it. Thank you for writing it up.

incidents.purposeHelp: Opening a report is logged with your reason.

profile.addCertHelp: Enter it as shown on your card. Bring the card to a supervisor to have it verified.
profile.expiryHint: Leave empty if it doesn't expire.

builder.customHint: Shown instead of the position, e.g. "Smith family rental".

builder.published_one: Published {{count}} shift. {{open}} went to the shift board.

approvals.description: Everything waiting for a supervisor, in one place.
approvals.claimsEmpty: Claims that would add overtime appear here.
approvals.punchesEmpty: Finished punches appear here for review before payroll.

claim.APPROVE: Approved. The shift moved to them.
claim.DENY: Declined. The shift stays on the board.

approvals.protectedNote: This is statutory leave. It usually can't be refused; declining asks for a reason that's recorded.
approvals.reasonHelp: The staff member sees this reason.
approvals.protectedDecline: Statutory sick days and protected leave usually can't be refused. Record why; it's audited.

timeOffDone.APPROVE: Approved. Their shifts in that time went to the board.
timeOffDone.DENY: Declined. They can see your reason.

certs.title: Certifications
certs.description: Verify cards staff added and see who needs to renew. Expired or unverified certifications never count for shifts.
certs.toVerifyHelp: Check the physical card or a photo before verifying.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Everyone on your team, their roles, positions and certifications.

staff.dobHint: Only used to apply young-worker rules.

settings.description: How your organization, facilities and pay rules are set up.
settings.payWeekHint: Weekly overtime is counted from this day.

settings.logoUrlHint: A secure (https) link to a PNG or SVG.
settings.facilitiesHelp: The province and time zone set the employment rules and clock times for each site.
settings.costCentreHint: Payroll needs this for every facility.
settings.radiusHint: How close staff must be to clock in.
settings.poolsHelp: Water-quality limits from your operating permit. Out-of-range readings recommend a closure.
settings.thresholdsHelp: Enter the limits exactly as your permit or health authority states them.

settings.positionCodes_one: {{count}} position-specific code is kept as is.

import.title: Import staff from a spreadsheet
import.columnsHelp: Needed: first_name, last_name, email. Optional: employment (full-time, part-time, casual, on call, volunteer), positions (separated by ;), roles (staff, head lifeguard, supervisor, front desk, hr, steward), hire_date and date_of_birth (YYYY-MM-DD), employee_number, phone, language (en or fr), union_member (yes/no). French column names work too. roles also accepts employee (general city worker) and your city's own role names.
import.sendInvites: Email each new person an invitation to set their password
import.skipNote: Rows to fix are skipped. Fix them in the file and import again; people already added won't be duplicated.

codes.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: {{value}} appears more than once in the file.

codes.NO_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER: No employee number; payroll will need one.

platform.accountHelp: Passkeys for signing in to the Dev console. Adding or removing one needs a sign-in from the last 10 minutes.
platform.mfaHelp: The Dev console needs a second step after your password. Use the passkey on this device or your security key.
platform.mfaSetUpHelp: The Dev console needs a passkey on top of your password. Set one up now with Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello or a security key. You'll use it every time you sign in.
platform.mfaExpired: Your sign-in timed out. Use a different account to start again.
platform.hosHelp: Blank = no limit. A shift that would break a limit can't be booked or claimed.

passkeys.help: Sign in with your face, fingerprint or device PIN instead of a password: Face ID and Touch ID, Android fingerprint or face unlock, Windows Hello, or a security key. Your fingerprint or face never leaves your device.
passkeys.added: Passkey added. Next time, sign in with it.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser can't use passkeys. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
passkeys.failed: That didn't work. Try again, or use your password.
passkeys.unknown: That passkey isn't set up for this organization. Sign in with your password, then add it from your profile.
passkeys.offerHelp: Use Face ID, your fingerprint or Windows Hello on this device instead of typing your password. It also confirms it's you for payroll and other sensitive changes.
passkeys.confirmHelp: This change needs a recent sign-in. Use your passkey or password to continue; you won't be asked again for 10 minutes.
passkeys.confirmWithPasskey: Use Face ID, fingerprint or Windows Hello

customRoles.noneHelp: Add one for each kind of non-aquatic job, e.g. Water Works Operator or Maintenance Worker.
customRoles.noPool: Pool status, water chemistry, headcounts, incidents and lessons are never part of a city role. Aquatic staff use the built-in aquatic roles.

customRoles.name: Role name

groupHelp.shiftBoard: Pick up and give away shifts with coworkers.

groupHelp.admin: HR-level access across the organization. Give it sparingly.
groupHelp.winter: Patrols, storm call-outs, patrol records and winter settings.

perms.roles.manage: Make roles and give them to people

how: Your attendance score starts at 100 and covers the last 90 days. Late clock-ins, missed shifts and giving away a shift with under 24 hours' notice lower it; picking up shifts raises it.
Sick days and protected leave never count. A supervisor can excuse anything else with a reason, and the reason stays visible to you.
Supervisors can add notes about your work, including commendations. You're notified each time and see exactly what they wrote.

The score and notes only help managers notice when a conversation may help. Nothing schedules, disciplines or ends your employment automatically; a person decides, and you can always respond in writing.
Every time a manager opens your file, it's logged. You can ask HR to correct anything inaccurate, and you have a right to see the information held about you.
people.skipsSteps: This skips steps in progressive discipline. Say in the summary why (for example, how serious the safety breach was), or choose an earlier step.

resultHelp.MINOR: Inspection saved. Your supervisor has been told about the defect.
resultHelp.MAJOR: Don't drive it. Your supervisor has been told and will arrange the repair.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Vehicles, the licence each needs, pre-trip inspections, defects and repairs.
fleet.noneHelp: Add plows, pickups, ice resurfacers: anything that needs a pre-trip inspection.
fleet.repairHint: Saved with the inspection, e.g. the work order number.
fleet.licenceHint: Only drivers holding it can inspect and take it.
fleet.foot: A vehicle is ready for 24 hours after a passing or minor inspection. Licences are certifications; add them to driving positions so the schedule checks them too.
